objectives.en: Say every fact from four times one to four times twelve without help.
objectives.yo: Sọ gbogbo fact láti four times one dé four times twelve láìsí ìrànlọ́wọ́.
objectives.pcm: Talk every fact from four times one reach four times twelve without help.

objectives.en: Answer any four times fact out of order.
objectives.yo: Dáhùn èyíkéyìí four times fact láìtẹ̀lé ètò.
objectives.pcm: Answer any four times fact wey no follow order.

curriculum.objective: Multiply whole numbers 1 x 1 up to 9 x 9, using a 10 by 10 square chart
curriculum.note: No scheme subdivides the 1x1 to 9x9 block by table; only the term is supported.

say.en: Look at three groups of four mangoes. Today we count in fours.
say.pcm: Look three groups of four mango. Today we go count four four.
say.yo: Wo groups three ti four mango. Lónìí a ó kà ní four four.

say.en: Today you will learn the four times table. Then you will say it by yourself.
say.pcm: Today you go learn table four. Then you go talk am by yourself.
say.yo: Lónìí ìwọ yóò kọ́ table four. Lẹ́yìn náà, ìwọ yóò sọ ọ́ fúnra rẹ.

say.en: Do you remember the three times table? What is three times four?
say.pcm: You remember table three? Three times four na how much?
say.yo: Ṣé o rántí table three? Kí ni three times four?

say.en: Three groups of four mangoes show this. We count four, eight, twelve. Four times three is twelve.
say.pcm: See three groups of four mango: four, eight, twelve. Four times three na twelve.
say.yo: Wo groups mẹ́ta ti four mango: four, eight, twelve. Four times three jẹ́ twelve.

say.en: Say it with me: four times three is twelve.
say.pcm: Say am with me: four times three na twelve.
say.yo: Sọ ọ́ pọ̀ mọ́ mi: four times three jẹ́ twelve.

say.en: Say the four times table. Start with four times one. End with four times twelve.
say.pcm: Say table four. Start with four times one. End with four times twelve.
say.yo: Sọ table four. Bẹ̀rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú four times one. Parí pẹ̀lú four times twelve.

say.en: Let us fix the ones you missed. Listen, then say them with me.
say.pcm: Make we fix the ones you miss. Hear them, then say them with me.
say.yo: Jẹ́ ká tún àwọn tí o pàdánù ṣe. Gbọ́, lẹ́yìn náà sọ wọ́n pọ̀ mọ́ mi.

say.pcm: Four times seven na how much?

say.en: Well done. Tomorrow we check the four times table once more. Then we start the five times table.
say.pcm: You do well. Tomorrow we go check table four again. Then we start table five.
say.yo: O ṣe dáadáa. Lọ́la a ó tún ṣàyẹ̀wò table four. Lẹ́yìn náà a ó bẹ̀rẹ̀ table five.
